components.css: .ds-text-link{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;min-height:44px;color:var(--ink,#e8efed);font:400 15px/1.6 var(--display, 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif);text-decoration:none;text-underline-offset:6px;transition:color .18s ease}.ds-file-kind{font:400 13px/1.6 var(--mono, 'Maple Mono', monospace);color:var(--muted,#a6b6b8)}.ds-text-link:hover{color:var(--cyan,#73f5dc);text-decoration:underline}.ds-text-link:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--cyan,#73f5dc);outline-offset:6px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-text-link{transition:none}}

components.name: Contact Copy Action
components.description: Outlined control on the acid contact field; the real page progressively enables clipboard behavior.
components.css: .ds-contact-sample{background:var(--acid,#e5fb6a);padding:24px}.ds-copy{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:12px;min-height:48px;background:transparent;color:var(--dark-ink,#101610);border:1px solid currentColor;border-radius:0;padding:10px 16px;font:400 14px/1.6 var(--display, 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif);cursor:pointer;transition:color .18s ease,background-color .18s ease,transform .2s var(--ease,cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1))}.ds-copy svg{width:20px;height:20px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.6;stroke-linecap:square;stroke-linejoin:miter}.ds-copy:hover{background:var(--dark-ink,#101610);color:var(--acid,#e5fb6a)}.ds-copy:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--dark-ink,#101610);outline-offset:6px}.ds-copy:active{transform:translateY(2px)}.ds-copy:disabled{cursor:wait}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-copy{transition:none}}

components.name: Focus Filters

components.css: .ds-filters{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}.ds-filters button{min-height:44px;font:400 13px/1.6 var(--mono, 'Maple Mono', monospace);padding:10px 14px;border:1px solid var(--line,#2d4248);border-radius:0;background:var(--ground,#080d10);color:var(--muted,#a6b6b8);cursor:pointer;transition:color .18s ease,background-color .18s ease,transform .2s var(--ease,cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1))}.ds-filters button[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--cyan,#73f5dc);border-color:var(--cyan,#73f5dc);color:var(--dark-ink,#101610)}.ds-filters button:hover{border-color:var(--cyan,#73f5dc);color:var(--ink,#e8efed)}.ds-filters button[aria-pressed=true]:hover{color:var(--dark-ink,#101610)}.ds-filters button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--cyan,#73f5dc);outline-offset:6px}.ds-filters button:active{transform:translateY(2px)}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-filters button{transition:none}}

components.name: Technology Inventory
components.description: Wrapping cyan text labels without capsule decoration.

narrative.overview:
Large, tightly set names and headings share the page with authored ASCII artwork and readable descriptions. The character is technical, direct, and personal: letterforms carry the identity, and each diagram points to a real system Jose built.

The user's explicit ASCII + cyberpunk direction governs the palette, terminal lettering, angular forms, fine dividing rules, and text artwork. These are intentional visual commitments. Keep the main reading voice clear and the terminal voice concentrated in artwork, metadata, and controls.
keyCharacteristics: Oversized grotesk headings with compact spacing.
Monospaced ASCII imagery and concise technical labels.
Dark tonal regions with cyan, acid-yellow, and a restrained warm accent.
Flat, square geometry with a clipped primary action.
Native disclosures, optional motion, and content available without JavaScript.

rules.name: The Contrast Pair Rule
rules.body: Bright cyan and acid fills take Dark Control Ink. The dark canvas takes Reading Ink or Quiet Metadata; do not use muted dark rules as body text.

rules.name: The Real Text Rule
rules.body: ASCII illustrations remain actual preformatted text with a meaningful surrounding label or caption. Hide decorative glyph strings from assistive technology; retain useful explanatory text.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Preserve tonal separation and fine rules when adding a surface. A shadow is not the current system's elevation language.

dos: Do preserve the user's ASCII + cyberpunk identity, including monospace, fine rules, and real text artwork.
Do pair large expressive headings with readable mixed-case descriptions.
Do carry the cyan and acid contrast pairs into new controls and focus states.
Do keep project content readable without scripts and use native elements for navigation and disclosures.
Do preserve motion controls, reduced-motion support, and explanatory captions for artwork.
donts: Don't replace authored diagrams with stock photos or fabricated project screenshots.
Don't add rounded card grids, glow, or shadow layers as though they were incumbent patterns.
Don't make every paragraph monospace or use tiny metadata as the main reading voice.
Don't turn warm diagram color into an unexplained action or status color.
Don't turn unverified claims, dates, or live-status indicators into visual decoration.
